name: On the Darkening Green
source:
A visual novel fairytale with horror elements where you play as Harper, a traveler navigating a strange forest with your companion, Glen.

This game was created for Utah Indie Game Jam 2017 in 48 hours, following the theme “Pacifist”.

[From [url=https://lightdiscordant.itch.io/on-the-darkening-green]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款带有恐怖元素的视觉小说童话故事，你将扮演哈珀，一名旅行者，与你的同伴格伦一起在陌生的森林中航行。

该游戏是为2017年犹他州独立游戏果酱大赛 (Utah Indie Game Jam 2017) 历时48小时制作的，主题为“和平主义者”。

[来自[url=https://lightdiscordant.itch.io/on-the-darkening-green]itch.io[/url]]
